title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.30226v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies provide strong behavioral priors for dexterous manipulation, yet adapting them on real robots remains challenging because high-DoF contact failures are difficult for humans to correct and online interaction is expensive. We present BORA, an offline-to-online reinforcement learning system that integrates an action-conditioned critic into a consistency-policy VLA and reuses the learned critic for frozen-base residual adaptation. To obtain executable corrective data, BORA combines wearable arm--hand teleoperation with a demonstration-guided local policy that translates coarse human intent into coordinated, embodiment-specific finger motions for contact-rich skills. Online robot rollouts and human corrections are mixed with offline data to update only a lightweight residual actor, avoiding full-model fine-tuning. We evaluate BORA on six real-world tasks using single-arm and bimanual platforms e

translated_title: BORA：连接离线强化学习与在线残差自适应以实现真实世界灵巧VLA模型
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为灵巧操作提供了强大的行为先验，但在真实机器人上对其进行自适应仍然具有挑战性，因为高自由度的接触失败难以由人类纠正，且在线交互成本高昂。我们提出了BORA，这是一个从离线到在线的强化学习系统，它将动作条件评论家整合到一致性策略VLA中，并复用学习到的评论家来实现冻结基座的残差自适应。为了获得可执行的纠正数据，BORA将可穿戴手臂-手部遥操作与演示引导的局部策略相结合，该策略将粗略的人类意图转化为协调的、特定于具身形态的手指动作，以应对接触密集型技能。在线机器人 rollout 和人类纠正数据与离线数据混合，仅用于更新轻量级残差执行器，从而避免全模型微调。我们在使用单臂和双臂平台的六个真实世界任务上对BORA进行了评估。
tldr: BORA提出了一种离线到在线强化学习框架，将动作条件评论家融入一致性策略VLA，结合可穿戴遥操作与演示引导局部策略获取可执行纠正数据，并仅训练轻量级残差执行器而无需全模型微调，实现了真实世界灵巧操作的高效自适应。
